notes: Henry Hubbell does NOT appear among the NAMED interments in the 1867 Antietam National Cemetery list (nearest surname present: 'Hubbard, Howard A.' — a non-match). A definitive NULL on the named roll is itself meaningful: it CORROBORATES the family tradition that Henry's body was never recovered/identified. He may lie among the NY unknowns, but no record names him.
